reserves.name: EUR bank reserves at EU CRR credit institutions

sources.label: AllUnity Trust Center reserve disclosure published 2026-09-16

reserveReview.rationale: AllUnity's Trust Center publication dated 2026-09-16 states that its stablecoins are fully backed by bank reserves held at EU CRR credit institutions and entirely segregated from operational funds. The current page still labels the reserve audit report as coming soon and does not publish bank identities, provider shares, or an instrument split. The disclosed full backing envelope therefore remains one euro bank-reserve category; the missing independent audit does not change the issuer-disclosed composition.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: AllUnity Trust Center full bank-reserve disclosure published 2026-09-16, read with the EURAU white paper v1.3 reserve terms
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No material reserve asset class is unclassified. Individual bank identities, provider shares, maturities, and rehypothecation terms are not disclosed, and the independent reserve audit remains unpublished.
